paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search with HAYSTAC Phase II
coupling_convention: |g_gamma / g_gamma^KSVZ| ratio (dimensionless, NOT converted to GeV^-1)
notes: HAYSTAC Phase II squeezed-state receiver axion haloscope search. Exclusion limits are reported as multiples of the KSVZ axion-photon coupling |g_gamma/g_gamma^KSVZ|, NOT in GeV^-1. Phase IId: 2.75x over 17.28-18.44 ueV (excluding mode crossings 17.89-18.08 and 18.13-18.18 ueV). Phase IIc: 2.96x over 18.71-19.46 ueV. Combined Phase II aggregate: 2.86x over 16.96-19.46 ueV. Earlier subphases (a,b) shown in Table I: 2.05x and 1.96x (these are the average couplings for 5.1sigma initial scans). Local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Lambda = 77.6 MeV. To convert ratios to g_agamma in GeV^-1, multiply by KSVZ value g_agamma^KSVZ which depends on mass. Downstream conversion required using KSVZ model; I have NOT applied this conversion and report raw ratios.
